interest_acquired_percent.justification: The company has agreed... to purchase a 100% interest in each of the Lone Pine Claim and the North Claim.

primary_commodity.justification: The Company holds 100% of the Maestro Gold-Silver-Molybdenum-Copper Property... It is focused on discovering and transacting high-value gold, silver, and copper projects.

verified_article_link.justification: The article is titled 'Quartz Expands Maestro Project Area with Acquisitions of Lone Pine Porphyry Deposit Claim and North Claim', which directly relates to the Maestro project.

currency.justification: The cash payment is listed as '$24,000'. The acquiring company, Quartz Mountain Resources Ltd., is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada and is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV), implying the currency is Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The North mineral claim was purchased from Shawn Merkley, an arms-length vendor, for $24,000, 45,000 common shares of the Company...

(750,000 + 45,000 = 795,000).
